$comment: ADR-0034 (3): genre-common thumbnail layout for the Pillow overlay onto the SDXL background. Coordinates are absolute pixels on a 1280x720 (16:9) canvas. Origin is top-left. Genre YAML files override font_primary/colors only; geometry here is shared across all 6 genres.

safe_area.$comment: Inset kept clear of YouTube UI overlays (duration pill, progress bar).

headline.$comment: Center-bottom large heading = the Japanese subtitle reused from the title (no separate LLM call). Uses font_secondary (Noto Sans JP) for Japanese glyph coverage.

subtext.$comment: Sub line under the headline: '{Genre EN} · 30 MIN'. Uses font_primary (genre display font).

text_positions.$comment: Named presets that genre YAML 'text_position' selects. Each remaps the headline/subtext anchor and y. x stays centered (640).
